title: How "synthetic insider" attacks raise the stakes for corporate cyber defense; a Verizon analysis of ~22K incidents found 12% were carried out by internal actors (Hannah Murphy/Financial Times)
summary: Hannah Murphy / Financial Times: How “synthetic insider” attacks raise the stakes for corporate cyber defense; a Verizon analysis of ~22K incidents found 12% were carried out by internal actors — Use of AI deepfake employees to infiltrate companies highlights wider risk of internal security breaches
